title: AIM tool adapter manifest
description: Declarative tool adapter. Adding a tool that uses an existing surface type is a new manifest file; only a new surface type requires code.

id.description: Stable tool id. Used as tool_raw when schema_tool is 'other'.

schema_tool.description: Value written to ai-usage-event.tool. Non-first-class tools use 'other'.

sanctioned.description: Policy hint only. Security own the real allowlist; false ⇒ unapproved-tool flag when observed.

implementation.description: generic = surface drivers only; legacy = delegate depth extraction to an existing collector package.

package.description: Repo-relative path to the existing collector package.

reason.description: Why depth stays in a hand-written package.

fidelity.description: Honest fidelity class for this surface on this tool.

paths.description: Path templates with ~, ${ENV}, and optional glob (* / **) expansion. File hits are discovery-only unless the basename matches session_glob.

session_glob.description: Glob under a discovery path for session/usage files. Comma-separated globs are OR'd (pathlib has no brace expansion).

format.description: Generic parser key. 'sqlite_table' SELECTs only field_map columns from a local SQLite state DB. 'legacy' defers to the legacy package.

field_map.description: Map logical fields (model, tokens_in, tokens_out, session_id, ts, tool_version, provider, repo_key) to source keys/columns.

records_key.description: For format=json_session, if the file is an object, read this array key (e.g. taskHistory on Cline ~/.cline/data/globalState.json). Defaults to 'events' when present.

sqlite.description: Options for format=sqlite_table. Only field_map source columns are SELECTed; content columns are hard-denied.

table.description: Table name (e.g. threads for Codex CLI state_*.sqlite).

source.description: ai-usage-event.source value for events from this surface.

forbidden_keys.description: Extra keys to strip beyond the runtime default set.
